text: Definition 6.1: for K > 0, a probabilistic oracle machine M is K-Lipschitz at oracle O if, for any other oracle O′, the supremum over inputs x of the change in the probability that M outputs 1 when given oracle O′ instead of O is strictly less than K times sup_z |P[O(z) = 1] − P[O′(z) = 1]|.
title: Paper Lipschitz definition
